content:
Let \(S=a+b+c\). Then
\[
29a+30b+31c = 30(a+b+c)+(c-a)=30S+(c-a)=366.
\]
So \(c-a=366-30S\). Since \(a,b,c\) are positive, \(|c-a|<S\).

If \(S\le 11\), then \(c-a\ge 366-330=36>S\), impossible.  
If \(S\ge 13\), then \(a-c=30S-366\ge 24>S\), impossible.  
Thus \(S=12\).

Now
\[
19a+20b+21c = 29a+30b+31c - 10(a+b+c)
=366-10\cdot 12=246.
\]

\[
\boxed{246}
\]
